# Operations

Every capability, as it appears on HTTP, MCP and the CLI.

## `cloud_login`

Add or change the iRobot account login. It's checked by logging in and saved only if that works. Optional: it adds room names, floor plans, cloud history, coverage, the live mission timeline and password retrieval; local control never needs it.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/cloud_login` |
| MCP | not on MCP |
| CLI | `roomba-kit cloud login [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | str | yes |  | iRobot account email |
| `password` | str | yes |  | iRobot account password. The CLI prompts for it; it is never echoed, returned or logged. |
| `country` | str | no | "US" | The account's country code, e.g. US, GB, DE |

**Result**

Type: `CloudLoginResult`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | "connected" \| "failed" | yes |  |
| `reason` | str \| None | no | Why it failed: `auth_failed`, `timeout`, `connection_failed`, … |

## `cloud_logout`

Remove the stored iRobot account login and disconnect from the cloud. Credentials supplied by environment variables still apply.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/cloud_logout` |
| MCP | tool `cloud_logout` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit cloud logout [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

_No fields._

**Result**

Type: `CloudStatus`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | "connected" \| "unavailable" \| "not_configured" | yes |  |
| `reason` | str \| None | no |  |
| `last_ok` | datetime \| None | no |  |

## `events_list`

List recorded events, oldest first, after `since`. Over HTTP, send `Accept: text/event-stream` to get the same events as a live SSE stream that resumes with `Last-Event-ID`.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/events` |
| MCP | tool `events_list` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit events list [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | int \| None | no | null | Return events with a seq greater than this; omit for the oldest |
| `robot` | str \| None | no | null | Only this robot (ID or unambiguous name) |
| `types` | list[EventType] \| None | no | null | Only these event types |
| `limit` | int | no | 100 | Most events to return |

**Result**

Type: `EventPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | list[Event] | yes |  |
| `next` | int | yes | Pass as `since` to continue after these events |

## `events_wait`

Wait for events after `since` and return them as soon as any arrive, or an empty list at the timeout. Call again with `next` to keep following.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/events/wait` |
| MCP | tool `events_wait` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit events wait [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | int | yes |  | Wait for events with a seq greater than this |
| `robot` | str \| None | no | null | Only this robot (ID or unambiguous name) |
| `types` | list[EventType] \| None | no | null | Only these event types |
| `timeout_s` | float | no | 30 | Seconds to wait before returning no events |

**Result**

Type: `EventPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | list[Event] | yes |  |
| `next` | int | yes | Pass as `since` to continue after these events |

## `get_position`

Where the robot is now: x/y in metres from the dock and heading in radians, with the map it's on. `{no_fix: true}` when it has no fix (for example while docked); that is not an error. During missions the same fixes stream as `position` events.
Supported on: braava_m6
Verification: braava_m6: verified

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/position` |
| MCP | tool `get_position` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit position [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |

**Result**

Type: `PositionFix | NoFix`


## `get_settings`

Read the robot's settings: every setting its model supports, null when the robot hasn't reported it.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/settings` |
| MCP | tool `get_settings` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit settings show [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |

**Result**

Type: `dict[str, bool | int | str | None]`


## `get_state`

Get a robot's full live state: battery, activity, current mission, last command, error and not-ready codes with readable text, Wi-Fi signal, stored map, robot schedules, lifetime counters, settings, and the bin, Clean Base, pad, tank and lid where the model has them. `at` is when the robot last reported; while it's offline this is the last state it reported.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/state` |
| MCP | tool `get_state` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit state [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |

**Result**

Type: `RobotState`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `at` | datetime | yes |  |
| `battery_pct` | int \| None | no |  |
| `activity` | Activity | no |  |
| `mission` | MissionRef \| None | no |  |
| `last_command` | CommandEcho \| None | no |  |
| `error` | CodeText \| None | no |  |
| `not_ready` | CodeText \| None | no |  |
| `signal` | Signal \| None | no |  |
| `map` | MapRef \| None | no |  |
| `schedules` | list[RobotSchedule] | no |  |
| `counters` | Counters | no |  |
| `bin` | BinState \| None | no |  |
| `clean_base` | CleanBaseState \| None | no |  |
| `pad` | PadState \| None | no |  |
| `tank` | TankState \| None | no |  |
| `lid_open` | bool \| None | no |  |
| `settings` | object | no |  |

## `mission_wait`

Wait until a robot's mission ends and return it with its outcome. Without `mission_id` it waits for the current mission, or the next one if none is running. Returns `{timeout: true, mission}` if it hasn't ended in time.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/missions/wait` |
| MCP | tool `mission_wait` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit missions wait [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |
| `mission_id` | str \| None | no | null | The mission to wait for; omit for the current or next mission |
| `timeout_s` | float | no | 1800 | Seconds to wait for the mission to end |

**Result**

Type: `Mission | MissionWaitTimeout`


## `set_setting`

Change one setting. It is reported applied only once the robot reports the new value; otherwise the error is `not_applied` with the value the robot holds.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `PUT /v1/robots/{robot}/settings/{setting}` |
| MCP | tool `set_setting` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit settings set [OPTIONS] ROBOT SETTING VALUE` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |
| `setting` | str | yes |  | Setting name: passes, edge_clean, always_finish, child_lock, eco_charge, schedule_hold, pad_wetness or spray_overlap |
| `value` | bool \| int \| str | yes |  | passes: auto\|one\|two. edge_clean, always_finish, child_lock, eco_charge, schedule_hold: true\|false. pad_wetness: 1\|2\|3. spray_overlap: standard\|deep\|extended. |

**Result**

Type: `SettingChange`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `setting` | str | yes |  |
| `requested` | any | yes |  |
| `outcome` | "applied" \| "not_applied" | yes |  |
| `actual` | any | yes |  |

## `token_create`

Create an API token and show it once. The `cli` token is also saved for the CLI.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | not on HTTP |
| MCP | not on MCP |
| CLI | `roomba-kit token create [OPTIONS] NAME` (CLI only) |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  | Token name, e.g. `cli` or `home-assistant` |

**Result**

Type: `TokenCreated`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `token` | str | yes | The plaintext token. Shown once; store it now. |
